value.rationale: A natural finite-size analogue of two-choice maximal averaging has a complete sharp answer: all active masks, a unique extremizing profile modulo symmetries, one algebraically specified eigenvalue, and a positive explicit exponential correction relative to the infinite-lattice constant. The correction captures boundary-induced localization and cannot be read off from the infinite norm alone; it is not an arbitrary parameter slice.
